sloka: भरतस्य वचः श्रुत्वा शत्रुघ्नः लक्ष्मण अनुजः ।न्यवर्तत ततः रोषात् ताम् मुमोच च मन्थराम् ॥२-७८-२४॥
transliteration: bharatasya vacaḥ śrutvā śatrughnaḥ lakṣmaṇa anujaḥ ।nyavartata tataḥ roṣāt tām mumoca ca mantharām ॥2-78-24॥

translations.english: Hearing the words of Bharata, Satrughna, the younger brother of Lakshmana restrained his fury and also released Manthara.
